cohort: 570 women in childbearing age who had been using oral contraception for at least three months.
finding: All groups of anti-androgenic oral contraceptives effectively reduced menstrual pain and acne severity, with cyproterone and drospirenone being the most effective drugs for treating hirsutism, while dienogest had no impact on body hairiness.
followup_time: At least 3 months after initiating contraception
